authority: Docs 01-11 define the AgentCode V1 architecture, product contract, roadmap, acceptance gates and phase-wise implementation playbook baseline. They are the locked baseline for every implementation decision.

documents.title: Model Selector
documents.authority: Model routing, model selection, provider choice at model level

documents.title: Code Intelligence, Context & Persistent Memory
documents.authority: Repository identity, file inventory, ignore semantics, Tree-sitter, exact search, symbols/imports, indexing, LSP lifecycle, context assembly, retrieval, durable vs derived memory

documents.title: Autonomy Kernel & Agent Runtime
documents.authority: Kernel ownership of mission/task/completion truth, SQLite V1 control plane, task leases, single authoritative Kernel writer, daemon process, event/state model

documents.title: Tools, Edit, Git, Sandbox, Skills, Hooks (HARDENED)
documents.authority: Tool Broker ownership, edit engine, Git/worktree architecture, sandbox and permission policy, skills and hooks

documents.title: Verification, Security & Red Team
documents.authority: Verification/evidence authority, security model, red-team scope

documents.title: Design Studio & Product UX
documents.authority: Desktop UX direction (Tauri 2 + React/TypeScript/Vite preferred V1), Design Studio, information architecture

documents.title: Implementation & OSS Extraction Blueprint
documents.authority: Extraction taxonomy (TAKE/ADAPT/WRAP/STUDY/IGNORE/REJECT), extraction records, reference catalog, license strategy, campaigns, language boundaries, tool installation strategy

documents.title: Product Requirements Document (PRD)
documents.authority: Product contract, scope, requirements and acceptance vocabulary

documents.title: Master Project Roadmap
documents.authority: Phase contracts HC-P00..HC-P29, milestone map, dependency graph, database/schema roadmap, build boundary direction, fixture registry

documents.title: Success Definition & Acceptance Gates
documents.authority: Gate definitions (P0-G1..P0-G7, P1-G1..P1-G8, P2-G1..P2-G8, ...), evidence classes E0..E6, global phase gates G-PHASE-01..10, gate result states

documents.title: Phase-Wise Implementation Playbook
documents.authority: Work Package model, canonical WorkPackageRecord, phase playbooks (P00..P29), execution envelopes, H1..H41 rules, session startup/shutdown, evidence and handoff rules

validation_rules: missing canonical file must be recorded verified:false
rename must update registry in the same commit
no two active documents may share an authority domain
